title: Angle change inside one continuous take (A5)

input.brief: Black heavy cotton hoodie with an embroidered City Harmony print. Stays warm and dry in bad weather.
input.story:
Scene 1 (5 seconds): 0-2 s: full-body shot, he walks in light rain. 2-4 s: the camera pushes in to his footsteps. 4-5 s: it pulls back to a medium shot as he stops.
Scene 2 (5 seconds): he pulls the hood down and smiles at the camera.

clip_contains_all: pulls back to a medium shot

note: Whole-word check: the fixed rules always say "no cuts", which is allowed; "cut" or "cut to" is not.
